note: Single source of truth for the tools hub grid and roadmap. Live entries render as cards on index.html; planned entries render in the On the roadmap section. Adding a tool = build the page, add an entry here, run scripts/generate_hub.py.

tools.name: LLM token & cost calculator
tools.desc: Count tokens and estimate cost per request, per day and per month across 29 models. Batch + cache discounts, long-context tiers and peak/off-peak rates handled automatically.

tools.name: JSON formatter & validator
tools.desc: Format, minify and validate JSON with exact error line and column. Shows size, key count and nesting depth at a glance.

tools.name: Regex tester
tools.desc: Test JavaScript regular expressions against live text, inspect capture groups, and preview replacements with match highlighting.

tools.name: Cron expression explainer
tools.desc: Translate any cron schedule into plain English and see the next runs in your local timezone.

tools.name: Base64 / URL / hash
tools.desc: Encode and decode text with Base64 and URL, escape HTML entities, and compute SHA checksums locally.

tools.name: Unix timestamp converter
tools.desc: Convert between Unix epoch, ISO 8601 and human-readable dates, live clock included.

tools.name: Password & UUID generator
tools.desc: Generate strong random passwords, memorable passphrases and v4 UUIDs with strength estimation.

tools.name: Meta tag & OG generator
tools.desc: Generate title, description, Open Graph and Twitter card tags with a live search result and social preview.

tools.name: Cron schedule builder
tools.desc: Pick days and times visually, get the cron expression — the reverse of the explainer.
tools.note: Pairs with the explainer; shares its parser/tests

tools.name: Subnet & CIDR calculator
tools.desc: Network/mask/wildcard/host range math for any IPv4 CIDR block.
tools.note: Pure JS integer math; classic bookmarked utility

tools.name: Self-hosted vs API break-even
tools.desc: Enter your monthly token volume, see where renting a GPU beats API pricing.
tools.note: Fits the ezaiops niche; competitors rank well for the query cluster

tools.name: Mortgage & loan calculator
tools.desc: Monthly payment, amortization schedule and extra-payment payoff scenarios.

tools.name: Image compressor & converter
tools.desc: Compress JPG/PNG and convert to WebP in the browser via canvas — nothing uploaded.
tools.note: Mass-market search volume; pure client-side, no server needed

tools.name: PDF merge & split
tools.desc: Merge, split and reorder PDF pages locally with pdf-lib.
tools.note: Huge volume, heavy competition from ilovepdf-class sites; long-tail only

tools.name: JWT debugger
tools.desc: Decode JWT header, payload and expiry locally with signature checks.
tools.note: Bathroom-break utility devs search for weekly

tools.name: Text diff checker
tools.desc: Side-by-side and inline diff for two blocks of text.
tools.note: Needs a small diff algorithm (Myers) or vendored lib

tools.name: Unit converter
tools.desc: Length, weight, temperature, area, speed and data size conversions.
tools.note: Low competition, steady but modest volume

tools.name: QR code generator
tools.desc: Generate QR codes as SVG or PNG, with error-correction level options.
tools.note: Mature space; differentiate on privacy (client-side rendering)
